Market today: The election results and a flight to safety are driving the market. Treasury yields are falling as investors move into bonds, which is generally not good for growth/tech names.

Your holdings: SMCI (-28.46%), SOXL (-67.47%), and SPAL (-42.9%) are deep in the red and need attention. These leveraged ETFs amplify drops, and your margin makes these losses sting more.

Watch: The market's reaction to the election outcome and the continued pressure on tech/leveraged ETFs.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your significant losses in the leveraged tech/chip names.
plays: Trim SMCI: The -28.46% loss is significant. Consider reducing exposure if it breaks below its stop.
Trim SOXL: The -67.47% loss is severe. Aggressively manage this position if it shows further weakness.
No new buys today - hold and watch
